title: Centrally symmetric Viterbo conjecture
statement: Every centrally symmetric convex body X in R^(2n) satisfies c_EHZ(X)^n≤n!·vol(X).

counterexample.description: A symmetric rational polytope with \(c_{EHZ}(X)^n>n!\operatorname{vol}(X)\) suffices. Exact volume and certified global action or billiard computation verify it.
